title: bank-collector transaction entry
description: One operation row as extracted from a bank cabinet page or imported from a statement export. A row from a cabinet run has date/amount/payee and whatever fields its profile names; a row from a statement import also carries the fixed statement fields declared below, including the own-transfer markers.

date.description: Operation date as shown on the page.

payee.description: Counterparty as shown on the page.

transaction_date.description: Statement import: posting date, ISO in value; value is null when the export's date could not be parsed.

title.description: Statement import: merchant, else comment, else the operation type.

category.description: Statement import: the bank's category of the operation.

type.description: Statement import: Списание (money out) or Пополнение (money in).

status.description: Statement import: the export's status of the operation.

comment.description: Statement import: the export's comment column.

mcc.description: Statement import: the merchant category code.

card.description: Statement import: the card name only — never the card number.

account.description: Statement import: the account name, NBSP collapsed.

account_last4.description: Statement import: the last four digits of the account number — never the full number.

own_transfer.description: Statement import: true when the bank itself marked the row as a transfer between the owner's own accounts (category "Между своими счетами" or a title starting "Перевод себе"). Exclude such rows from income/expense totals.

own_transfer_reason.description: Statement import: which bank signal flagged the row — "category", "title", or an empty string when it was not flagged.

own_transfer_pair.description: Statement import: the short id ("p1", "p2", …) of the 1:1 pair this flagged row belongs to, or an empty string when it has no counterpart in the statement.

raw.description: The string exactly as it was read from the page.

value.description: Normalised value: a plain decimal string for money, the trimmed text otherwise.

currency.description: Currency taken from the string itself; null when the page showed none. Never guessed.

money.description: True when the value was recognised as a money string.
